title: AutoComplete
description: A text input that suggests matching options while the user types.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.arrows: Arrow Down / Arrow Up move through the visible options (wrapping around).
keyboard.enter: Enter selects the active option (disabled options are skipped) without submitting the surrounding form.
keyboard.escape: Escape closes the dropdown and keeps focus in the input; with the dropdown already closed it clears the text (onChange receives ""). Inside a Modal or Popover only the dropdown closes.
keyboard.aria: The input exposes the combobox role with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant pointing to the listbox options.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label of the input (without it, give the input an accessible name with
inputProps["aria-label"] or an enclosing FormControl label)

props.name: mode
props.description:
"basic" renders icon / label / description; "custom" uses the `option`
slot

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Returns the group name of an option; options are grouped under headings

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading indicator in the dropdown

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Props / attributes forwarded to the underlying Input (native
attributes, aria-label, size, variant, prefix / suffix, clearable,
disabled, readOnly, listeners...)

props.name: emptyProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the default Empty state

props.name: dropdownClassName
props.description:
Additional class name of the dropdown (teleported) element. It can set
the CSS custom properties `--auto-complete-dropdown-background`,
`--auto-complete-option-hover-background` and
`--auto-complete-option-highlight-background`

props.name: placement
props.description:
Preferred dropdown side; the dropdown is aligned with the input's start
edge, is at least as wide as the input, and flips / shifts to stay in the
viewport

props.name: offset
props.description:
Dropdown offset in pixels. For top / bottom placements `y` is the gap to
the input and `x` shifts along it; for left / right placements `x` is
the gap and `y` shifts along it

props.name: animation
props.description: Animates the dropdown when it opens

props.name: filterOption
props.description: Custom filter; by default options whose label contains the input (case-insensitive) are shown

props.name: sortOption
props.description: Compare function used to sort the filtered options

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description:
Makes the first enabled option active whenever the dropdown opens or the
options change, so Enter picks it right away

props.name: fillOnSelect
props.description:
Writes the label of the picked option into the input. Set to false to
keep the typed text, e.g. when picking navigates away

props.name: groupMode
props.description:
How groupBy groups options: "first" collects each group at its first
appearance; "adjacent" groups runs of consecutive options (a group can
appear several times). Options whose group is "" get no heading

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Custom content shown when no option matches (React `renderEmpty`)

vars.name: --auto-complete-dropdown-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the dropdown (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --auto-complete-dropdown-max-height
vars.description: Maximum height of the option list before it scrolls

vars.name: --auto-complete-option-padding-y
vars.description: Vertical padding of an option (follows the density's row padding)

vars.name: --auto-complete-option-padding-x
vars.description: Horizontal padding of an option and of a group label

vars.name: --auto-complete-option-hover-background
vars.description: Background of the hovered / keyboard-focused option

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AutoComplete, Button, VStack } from "minerva-design/vue";
const options = [
  {
    label: "Vue",
    value: "vue",
    description: "Progressive framework",
    group: "Frontend",
  },
  {
    label: "Angular",
    value: "angular",
    description: "Application platform",
    group: "Frontend",
  },
  {
    label: "Node.js",
    value: "node",
    description: "JavaScript runtime",
    group: "Backend",
  },
];
const query = ref("");
const loaded = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
async function load() {
  loading.value = true;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  loaded.value = true;
  loading.value = false;
}
</script>
<template>
  <VStack :gap="3" align="stretch"
    ><AutoComplete
      v-model="query"
      label="Remote suggestions"
      :options="loaded ? options : []"
      :loading="loading"
    /><Button @click="load" :loading="loading">Load suggestions</Button></VStack
  >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AutoComplete, type AutoCompleteOption } from "minerva-design/vue";
const options = [
  { label: "Germany", value: "de" },
  { label: "Denmark", value: "dk" },
  { label: "France", value: "fr" },
  { label: "Finland", value: "fi" },
  { label: "Greece", value: "gr" },
];
const filter = (text: string, option: AutoCompleteOption) =>
  option.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(text.toLowerCase());
const sort = (a: AutoCompleteOption, b: AutoCompleteOption) =>
  a.label.localeCompare(b.label);
</script>
<template>
  <AutoComplete
    label="Country (starts with)"
    :options="options"
    :filter-option="filter"
    :sort-option="sort"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: AutoComplete
translationResources.description: A text input that suggests matching options while the user types.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Options whose label contains the typed text are suggested; inputProps are forwarded to the input.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: value / onChange control the input text, onSelect reports the chosen option and onDropdownVisibleChange the dropdown state.

rich-options.title: Icons, descriptions and states
rich-options.description: In basic mode an option can have an icon and a description, and can be highlighted or disabled.

custom-render.title: Custom rendering
custom-render.description: Set mode="custom" and renderOption to fully control how options look; renderEmpty replaces the empty state.

grouped.title: Grouped options
grouped.description: groupBy returns a group name for each option; groups are shown under headings in order of appearance.

filter-sort.title: Custom filter and sort
filter-sort.description: filterOption replaces the default "contains" matching and sortOption orders the results.

async-loading.title: Remote search
async-loading.description: Fetch options as the user types and show loading while the request is pending.

appearance.title: Dropdown placement and colors
appearance.description: Customize placement, offset and animation, and recolor the dropdown, hovered and highlighted options with the --auto-complete-dropdown-background, --auto-complete-option-hover-background and --auto-complete-option-highlight-background CSS custom properties set through dropdownClassName. The dropdown is aligned with the input's start edge, is at least as wide as the input, and flips / shifts to stay in the viewport.

search-box.title: Search box
search-box.description: autoHighlight makes Enter pick the first suggestion, fillOnSelect={false} keeps the typed text, and onSubmit runs a search when no option is active.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.arrows: Arrow Down / Arrow Up move through the visible options (wrapping around).
keyboard.enter: Enter selects the active option (disabled options are skipped) without submitting the surrounding form.
keyboard.escape: Escape closes the dropdown and keeps focus in the input; with the dropdown already closed it clears the text (onChange receives ""). Inside a Modal or Popover only the dropdown closes.
keyboard.aria: The input exposes the combobox role with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant pointing to the listbox options.

AutoCompleteProps.name: Name of the input
AutoCompleteProps.label: Label of the input
AutoCompleteProps.mode: "basic" renders icon / label / description; "custom" uses renderOption
AutoCompleteProps.onChange: Called when the input text changes (typing or selecting an option)
AutoCompleteProps.onSelect: Called when an option is picked (mouse or keyboard)
AutoCompleteProps.groupBy: Returns the group name of an option; options are grouped under headings
AutoCompleteProps.renderOption: Custom option renderer (used when mode is "custom")
AutoCompleteProps.renderEmpty: Custom content shown when no option matches
AutoCompleteProps.loading: Shows a loading indicator in the dropdown
AutoCompleteProps.inputProps: Props forwarded to the underlying Input (native attributes, aria-label, size, prefix / suffix, clearable...)
AutoCompleteProps.emptyProps: Props forwarded to the default Empty state
AutoCompleteProps.dropdownClassName: Additional class name of the dropdown (portalled) element. It can set the --auto-complete-dropdown-background, --auto-complete-option-hover-background and --auto-complete-option-highlight-background CSS custom properties to recolor the dropdown, hovered options and highlighted options
AutoCompleteProps.placement: Preferred dropdown side; the dropdown is aligned with the input's start edge, is at least as wide as the input, and flips / shifts to stay in the viewport
AutoCompleteProps.offset: Dropdown offset in pixels: for top / bottom placements y is the gap to the input and x shifts along it; for left / right placements x is the gap
AutoCompleteProps.animation: Animates the dropdown when it opens
AutoCompleteProps.filterOption: Custom filter; by default options whose label contains the input (case-insensitive) are shown
AutoCompleteProps.sortOption: Compare function used to sort the filtered options
AutoCompleteProps.onOptionClick: Called when an option is clicked with the mouse
AutoCompleteProps.onDropdownVisibleChange: Called when the dropdown opens or closes (not on mount)
AutoCompleteProps.onSubmit: Called with the trimmed text when Enter is pressed while no option is active (e.g. to search)
AutoCompleteProps.autoHighlight: Makes the first enabled option active whenever the dropdown opens or the options change
AutoCompleteProps.fillOnSelect: Writes the label of the picked option into the input
AutoCompleteProps.className: Additional class name of the root element
AutoCompleteProps.groupMode: "first" groups options at their first appearance, "adjacent" groups runs of consecutive options; group "" has no heading

AutoCompleteOption.label: Text displayed for the option and written to the input when selected
AutoCompleteOption.disabled: Prevents the option from being selected
AutoCompleteOption.highlight: Highlights the option (e.g. as a recommendation)
AutoCompleteOption.icon: Icon displayed before the label (basic mode)
AutoCompleteOption.description: Secondary text displayed under the label (basic mode)
AutoCompleteOption.group: Free-form group identifier, typically read by groupBy

cssVars.--auto-complete-dropdown-max-height: Maximum height of the option list before it scrolls
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-padding-y: Vertical padding of an option (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-padding-x: Horizontal padding of an option and of a group label
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-hover-background: Background of the hovered / keyboard-focused option
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-highlight-backgro: Background of options with highlight: true

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Set the options JS property; typing filters them by label. Picking an option fills the input and fires minerva-select; Enter with no active option fires minerva-submit with the typed text.

rich-options.title: Rich and grouped options
rich-options.description: Options can have an icon, a description, a highlight or be disabled; groupBy puts them under headings. auto-highlight makes the first enabled option active so Enter picks it; variant and size style the input.

custom-render.title: Custom rendering and filtering
custom-render.description: With mode="custom", renderOption returns each option's content (string, DOM node or Lit template). filterOption here also matches the email, sortOption orders by name and renderEmpty replaces the empty state.

async-loading.title: Asynchronous loading
async-loading.description: Listen to minerva-input to fetch matches as the user types and set loading meanwhile. The prefix slot holds an icon; minerva-change reports the committed text.

props.variant: Visual style of the input: outline, filled or unstyled.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but no dropdown.
props.noFillOnSelect: Keeps the typed text when an option is picked (no fill-in).
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled fieldset (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message describing the current validation error, empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element is a candidate for constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The native change of the input, re-dispatched from the host (on blur after editing).
events.minerva-input: The input text changed: typing, picking an option or Escape clearing (detail: { value }).
events.minerva-change: The text was committed: an option filled it in, Escape cleared it, or the native change on blur (detail: { value }).
events.minerva-select: An option was picked with the mouse or the keyboard (detail: { value, option }).
events.minerva-submit: Enter was pressed with no active option and non-blank text (detail: { value }, trimmed).
events.minerva-open-change: The dropdown opens or closes (detail: { open }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.

cssVars.--input-height: Minimum height of the field, for every size (defaults to the density's control height of the size).
cssVars.--input-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the text, for every size.
cssVars.--input-background: Background color of the outline variant.
cssVars.--input-focus-color: Border color while hovered or focused.

methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets (or clears, with "") a custom validation error.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by the browser on form.reset(): restores the value attribute.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by the browser when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by the browser to restore the value (back/forward cache, autofill).
